title: KunAgent/Kun
claim: Kun — an open agent workspace that chains requirement-clarification → UI design → code → writing into one loop, built to run well on cheap Chinese models (DeepSeek, Xiaomi MiMo, MiniMax).
why_good: Kun is a local-first AI agent workspace with a desktop GUI and terminal TUI that unifies coding, writing, design, research, and automation into one continuous workflow. Its standout capability is the Agent Graph, which breaks complex tasks into a dependency graph with sub-agents, supervision, and acceptance checks, all while supporting cheap Chinese models like DeepSeek and MiMo.
value: Solo developers and small agencies in China pay for a local-first AI workspace that can run on cheap models, saving on API costs and keeping data private, and they pay for the convenience of having code, writing, and design in one tool.
risk: The risk is that Cursor or a similar incumbent adds a local-first, multi-model mode with a GUI, and Kun's user base—mostly developers—will just use that instead of switching to an open-source tool.
does: Kun is a local-first AI agent workspace with a desktop GUI and terminal TUI that unifies coding, writing, design, research, and automation into one continuous workflow. Its standout capability is the Agent Graph, which breaks complex tasks into a dependency graph with sub-agents, supervision, and acceptance checks, all while supporting cheap Chinese models like DeepSeek and MiMo.
edge: Demand-clarification-first workflow plus first-class support for cost-efficient Chinese models, instead of a thin shell over one expensive API.
why_use: Unlike a plain chatbox or scattered tools, Kun keeps the entire journey from requirement to acceptance visible and auditable—plans, diffs, test results, and review findings are all attached to the task. It also lets you switch between GUI and TUI without losing state, and it doesn't lock you into one model provider.
hook: Developers and small teams in China are tired of juggling ChatGPT, Cursor, and design tools to turn an idea into a working product, and they want it to run on cheap local models without data leaving their machine.

zh.claim: Kun 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，将需求澄清、UI 设计、代码和写作串联成一个循环，专为在 DeepSeek、小米 MiMo、MiniMax 等廉价中国模型上良好运行而设计。
zh.hook: 中国的开发者和自由职业者厌倦了在 ChatGPT、Cursor 和设计工具之间来回切换，他们希望有一个能在廉价本地模型上运行、数据不出本机的工具，把想法变成可交付的产品。
zh.does: Kun 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，提供桌面 GUI 和终端 TUI，将编程、写作、设计、研究和自动化统一到一个连续的工作流中。其突出能力是 Agent Graph，它可以将复杂任务分解为依赖图，由子代理分工、监督和验收，同时支持 DeepSeek、MiMo 等廉价中国模型。
zh.why_use: 与普通的聊天框或分散的工具不同，Kun 将需求到验收的整个过程保持可见和可审计——计划、差异、测试结果和审查发现都附在任务上。它还允许在 GUI 和 TUI 之间切换而不丢失状态，并且不锁定单一模型提供商。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用：它是一个开源项目，需要自托管和配置，没有围绕它构建的精美产品，尤其缺乏面向非技术用户或中国市场的产品。
zh.counter: 这是一个拥挤的领域：Cursor、Windsurf 和 Devin 已经占据了 AI 编程代理市场，OpenAI/Anthropic 也可能添加类似的一体化工作区功能，从而消灭独立工具的需求。
zh.differentiator: 将 Kun 打包成一个开箱即用的中国本地产品，预配置 DeepSeek/MiMo 接入，一键安装，中文支持，面向不想碰终端的非技术创作者。
zh.value: 中国的独立开发者和小型机构付费购买本地优先的 AI 工作区，可以在廉价模型上运行，节省 API 成本并保护数据隐私，同时享受代码、写作和设计一体化工具的便利。
zh.risk: 风险在于 Cursor 或类似现有产品增加了本地优先、多模型模式并带有 GUI，而 Kun 的用户群——主要是开发者——会直接使用它，而不是转向开源工具。
zh.why_good: Kun 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，提供桌面 GUI 和终端 TUI，将编程、写作、设计、研究和自动化统一到一个连续的工作流中。其突出能力是 Agent Graph，它可以将复杂任务分解为依赖图，由子代理分工、监督和验收，同时支持 DeepSeek、MiMo 等廉价中国模型。

pick_reason: KunAgent/Kun addresses a clear need for integrated AI tools in software development, though competition in the space is significant.
gap: No verified pain; it's a developer tool with no clear non-technical user gap.
counter: This is a crowded space: Cursor, Windsurf, and Devin already own the AI coding agent market, and OpenAI/Anthropic could add a similar all-in-one workspace feature, killing the need for a separate tool.
differentiator: Package Kun as a turnkey, China-local product with pre-configured DeepSeek/MiMo access, one-click installer, and Chinese-language support, targeting non-technical creators who want an all-in-one AI workspace without touching a terminal.
